summary: Adtran Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the election of Anne DelSanto as a new independent director, effective July 1, 2026, increasing board size. The appointment is routine, with no departure or abrupt change; DelSanto will serve on the Compensation Committee. Terms are standard for non-employee directors. No activists, premiums, or strategic events are involved. This is an ordinary board addition, not a forced change, so it is only weakly classified as Management Changes.
